editorial_proposal.argument_summary: Crawford prefers El while acknowledging no extant Hebrew witness for that phrase. Greek permits more than one Hebrew retroversion. Her proposed history relates Israel to expansion before El and the Qumran form to substitution of a more common divine term.

pob_assessment.working_phrase_basis: Existing published 4Q37 transcription, not the OHB conjecture
pob_assessment.counterargument: The conjecture offers a possible common ancestor of the readings; its explanatory appeal must be weighed against direct Hebrew attestation and the non-unique Greek retroversion.
pob_assessment.decision: Retain the attested working candidate and record the conjecture as an alternative for editorial review; do not count a modern edition as another physical witness.
